name: Solcast
tagline: High-accuracy solar irradiance and PV power forecasts via REST API
description: Solcast provides high-accuracy solar irradiance and photovoltaic (PV) power forecast and live data via a REST API. Developers use it for solar resource assessment, short-term PV power forecasting, and grid/energy management applications. A free tier is available for limited API use.

auth.details: API key via query parameter or Authorization header; self-serve signup at Solcast Toolkit.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Evaluation: up to 15 Historic Time Series and 10 Live/Forecast requests at user locations; unlimited at unmetered locations. Researchers receive 50 free historical requests. Home hobbyists receive 10 requests/day for one residential site.

rate_limits: Enforced per API key and dependent on the subscription plan/product. Current limits are shown in the API Toolkit and response headers; exceeding a rate limit returns HTTP 429 with Retry-After.
use_cases: get live solar irradiance for a lat/lon
fetch PV power forecast for a site
